freeze_boundary: Defined before any physical return-to-home run (WP-11 Phase D, 2026-10-30). Engineering choices, not calibrated; a change is a new version. The home outcome is reported separately from the task outcome and never changes a task verdict.

retract.scope: RETRACTING: straight Cartesian lift of the knife edge along world +z, orientation held, to the HOME edge height (FK(q_home) edge z), Newton IK chained sample to sample from the measured joints. No lift when the edge is already at or above that height.

rotate.scope: RETURNING_HOME, part 1: joint-space move to IK(edge at the lifted xy and HOME height, HOME orientation) seeded at q_home (hand-down, blade hanging). If that IK does not converge or its path fails preflight, the direct joint-space move to q_home is tried; every attempt is recorded.

joint_limits.scope: Synchronized trapezoidal joint profiles; Franka Panda limits are 2.175-2.61 rad/s. Commanded joint velocity <= max_velocity on every control step is a hard plan gate; acceleration is enforced for joint-space segments and reported for the Cartesian lift.

preflight.checker: scripts/preflight_wp11_orientations.py GeometryModel (official Franka colliders, finger visual hulls, profile handle/blade hulls, v5 wrist D405 boxes, D455, board/riser/table, workpiece base and protrusion hulls, parked Franka 1), via robotic_cutting_sim.motion_preflight
preflight.blade_workpiece: RETRACTING samples: no penetration of the declared (uncut) workpiece geometry (clearance >= 0); every later sample: the C2 free-space clearance (2 mm). Other pairs use the C2 thresholds.

outcome.scope: home_outcome PASS needs: plan preflight PASS, the trajectory fully executed, grasp never lost, final joints within max_home_joint_error_rad of q_home after settle_s, final tool body pose within the translation/rotation bounds of the tool pose measured right after the reset pregrasp settle, grasp slip/rotation since settling within the bounds (the GraspMonitor warning gates), zero material cut-label changes, zero native unintended tool contacts (palm/table/fixture/other), and the measured joint path passing the same geometric clearance check.
